preconditions: PET stream segregated; low PVC and contamination; moisture controlled
potential_output: rPET flakes/pellets or polyester fiber feedstock
critical_tests: Polymer ID, IV where relevant, contamination, color, moisture, mechanical properties
limitations: Food-contact uses require dedicated approved process and compliance; not guaranteed by recycling alone
reference_basis: General polymer recycling practice; validate with recycler specifications

preconditions: Separate HDPE by color and grade; remove chemical residues
potential_user_industries: Pipes (non-pressure if qualified), crates, pallets, construction products
limitations: Pressure pipes and safety-critical parts require strict standards and traceability

preconditions: Known PP grade; avoid mixed polymers; low moisture
potential_user_industries: Injection molding, household goods, logistics products
limitations: Properties may degrade; blend design and application qualification needed

preconditions: Clean and sorted film; contamination and moisture controlled
potential_user_industries: Garbage bags, liners, non-critical film and molded products
limitations: Post-consumer films may be heavily contaminated; economics depend on washing yield

preconditions: Segregated alloy family; remove oils/coolants; no mixed ferrous parts
potential_user_industries: Foundries, die casting, aluminium product manufacturers
critical_tests: Spectrometry/alloy chemistry, inclusions, hydrogen/porosity as relevant
limitations: Different alloys cannot be indiscriminately mixed; licensed furnace and emissions controls

preconditions: Known cable type; use licensed mechanical separation; no open burning
process_route: Cable chopping → granulation → density separation → copper fraction
potential_output: Copper granules or secondary copper feed
critical_tests: Copper purity, insulation residue, moisture, contaminants
limitations: Hazardous insulation and e-waste handling rules may apply
reference_basis: WMRA licensed facility categories; industrial practice

preconditions: Untreated, unpainted, dry wood; segregated by type
critical_tests: Moisture, particle size, resin compatibility, formaldehyde emissions of finished panel
limitations: Treated/painted wood may be unsuitable; binder and emissions compliance required
confidence_label: Potential route; verify feedstock and standards

preconditions: Known fiber composition; clean and dry; color sorted
potential_user_industries: Automotive interiors, insulation, cleaning products, furniture
critical_tests: Fiber composition, tensile, flammability, chemical residues
limitations: Blended fibers reduce mechanical recycling options

preconditions: PET-rich composition; elastane and other fibers quantified
process_route: Mechanical fiber opening or specialized chemical recycling
critical_tests: Fiber composition, dye/finish residues, tensile and color
limitations: Chemical recycling requires specialized facilities and solvent/process controls
confidence_label: Potential route; facility capability must be confirmed

process_route: Optical sorting → crushing → cullet conditioning → remelting
critical_tests: Color, ceramic contamination, particle size, chemical composition
limitations: Ceramics/heat-resistant glass can disrupt furnace batches

preconditions: Dry, segregated grades; low food/oil contamination
process_route: Pulping → screening → deinking if required → sheet forming
potential_user_industries: Packaging, paper mills, molded pulp packaging
critical_tests: Moisture, ash, fiber grade, contaminants, strength
limitations: Fiber length declines with repeated recycling; coated/wet-strength papers may be difficult

preconditions: Source-specific slag characterization and aging; regulatory acceptance
process_route: Metal recovery → aging → crushing/screening → engineered use
potential_output: Processed slag aggregate or cementitious input
critical_tests: Free CaO/MgO, expansion, leaching, gradation, strength
limitations: No construction use before environmental and engineering testing
confidence_label: Conditional route; testing and approval mandatory

preconditions: Known combustion source; chemistry and loss-on-ignition acceptable
critical_tests: LOI, fineness, oxide chemistry, heavy metals, leaching
limitations: Source variability and local construction standards govern use

preconditions: High gypsum purity; low chlorides and trace contaminants
process_route: Dewatering → drying → milling → calcination as required
potential_user_industries: Gypsum board, cement, agricultural applications where approved
limitations: Agricultural use requires contaminant assessment and regulatory approval

preconditions: Traceable food-grade organic stream; exclude packaging/chemicals
process_route: Pre-treatment → anaerobic digestion → gas upgrading/digestate management
potential_user_industries: Energy users, farms/soil amendments subject to quality
critical_tests: Total solids, volatile solids, C/N, salinity, pathogens, contaminants
limitations: Digestate is not automatically a certified fertilizer; permitting required
confidence_label: Potential route; process design and permits required

preconditions: Licensed tire processing; safe storage and fire prevention
potential_user_industries: Rubber tiles, molded goods, asphalt modifiers
critical_tests: Particle size, steel/fiber content, contaminants, PAHs where relevant
limitations: End-use standards and local environmental permits apply

preconditions: Licensed e-waste chain and specialist processor
process_route: Manual/mechanical dismantling → concentration → specialist metal recovery
critical_tests: Hazardous component inventory, metal assays, emissions controls
limitations: Not suitable for informal dismantling or open burning

preconditions: Dewatered mineral sludge; chemistry and particle size known
potential_output: Mineral filler or engineered construction products
critical_tests: Moisture, particle size, mineralogy, salts, contaminants, strength
limitations: Use in products only after formulation and performance testing
